items.headline: O: Daybreak for Frontline Defenders $1B commitment
items.summary: O expanded subsidized access for frontline cyber defenders via its Daybreak program. Announcement frames training/support/partnerships as scaled enablement for government security teams.

items.headline: O: math progress results published
items.summary: O shared newly published AI-generated mathematics progress, including releasing results to a public repository with protocols for paper revisions and citations.

items.headline: V: fleet scale-up and more missions planned
items.summary: Credible coverage reports V operating multiple reentry spacecraft and planning additional missions through year-end 2026 and 2027, supporting manufacturing capacity ramp.

items.headline: V: $251M Series D at $1.6B valuation
items.summary: V announced a $251M Series D to scale space-based pharmaceutical processing; company says funding supports increased launch/reentry cadence and deeper pharma partnerships.
